question: Does diversifying the generator sources used for gate fitting and selection improve transfer to a generator excluded from both, at fixed training and tuning image counts?
status: exploratory study on previously inspected development sources, not blind final testing
experts: Existing Round 8 A matched global/local experts remain frozen; gate inputs for both arms use original-view cached features and raw expert logits.
control_fit: 250 original gate-fit Real + 250 original gate-fit SD15
mixed_fit: Same 250 Real + 125 SD15 subset + 125 donor fake originals
control_tuning: 124 original selection Real + 124 original selection SD15
mixed_tuning: Same 124 Real + 62 SD15 subset + 62 donor fake originals
donor_split: For each of ADM and BigGAN, SHA-256-sort source_id with fixed study salt, take first125 fit, next62 tune, remaining113 unused; shared across the three data seeds. All transformed views stay with their original.
evaluation: Held-out fake generator300 originals + disjoint development Real300 originals; all four conditions. Held-out generator excluded from both fitting and tuning for that fold. Every model/settings in every fold frozen before evaluation.
gate: Unchanged8->32 ReLU->1 sigmoid; original8 score/quality inputs; score_gate masks final3 standardized quality features; paired initialization, BCE full-batch updates, AdamW lr.003 weight_decay.0001, max400 epochs, original BCE patience40.
checkpoints: Save BOTH earliest lowest tuning BCE and earliest highest tuning macroAUROC from the SAME BCE-patience-stopped trajectory. AUROC-selected is primary, BCE-selected is secondary. Improvement tolerance1e-6; epoch0 included.
tuning_macro: Equal mean over each source fake generator x each of3 tuning conditions, each paired with the shared tuning Real images. Do not duplicate Real in original-image counts.
fixed_alpha: Grid0..1 by.1, maximize same tuning macroAUROC, absolute ties within1e-6 choose nearest.5 then smaller.
threshold: Recompute pooled tuning Youden-J for EVERY model/checkpoint/baseline in its own source arm. Original finite-cutoff tie rule (closest probability threshold.5). Keep threshold fixed across target conditions.
aggregation: Average gate-initialization metrics within each data seed; then equal mean of3 shared-pool data seeds and2 held-out generators x4 conditions. Also report every seed and condition.
uncertainty: 1000 paired class-stratified original-image bootstrap draws, seed20261108, common Real draws across both target generators and common identity draws across conditions/models/seeds. Conditional on already-fitted models; percentile95% intervals exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment or independent-replication claim.
exclusions: No final/reserved-test manifests, images, predictions or scores. No pretrained feature extraction, expert refit, architecture search, hyperparameter sweep or performance-driven retry.
interpretation: Treatment changes generator diversity in BOTH gate fitting and selection; not a training-only causal claim. Shared donor splits/real images/pools and previously inspected generators limit generalization claims. Report all outcomes.
